answer: The timber of trust is forged through recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments that bind identity to verifiable history, ensuring no entity can forge a credible profile without exponential computational cost. By integrating verifiable delay functions, the system enforces a sequential thread of proof that prevents parallel identity cloning, rendering brute-force attacks information-theoretically unfeasible as the delay grows super-linearly, thus securing the network against Sybil adversaries who cannot rapidly generate the required cryptographic thread.
